tools.name: onboarding_next_step
tools.description: Pre-connection onboarding helper, callable before any SMI token is set. With no input, returns the fork question "Do you already have an SMI token?" — call again with hasToken: "yes" for connect guidance (then verify_access), or hasToken: "no" for prospect-intake guidance. Runs locally; makes no net

tools.name: verify_access
tools.description: Verifies the session Personal Access Token (PAT) against the SMI identity endpoint and returns the resolved account identity.

tools.name: smi_get_cowork_instructions
tools.description: Returns a consolidated, copy-paste-ready Markdown system prompt of SMI Aware house rules and a when-to-call-which-tool routing guide, plus exact paste-in locations for Claude Projects/Cowork/Desktop, Cursor, and other clients, so the assistant calls the right smi_* tools automatically. Runs locally;

tools.name: submit_contact_request
tools.description: Submits a prospect contact request — first name, last name, email, and organization — to SMI so the sales team can follow up. For prospects who do not yet have an SMI Aware token.

tools.name: smi_list_deep_reports
tools.description: Lists SMI deep reports with pagination and optional filtering.

tools.name: smi_get_deep_report
tools.description: Fetches a single SMI deep report by id. Research Bundles are deep-report products, so use this tool for a Research Bundle id too rather than constructing a research_bundle: reference for the generic fetch tool. Accepts product-prefixed ids: RB-11751 (Research Bundle) and DR-11751 (Deep Report) both

tools.name: smi_create_deep_report
tools.description: Creates one or more SMI deep report drafts from subject orders. Returns the draft ids for review before submission. All orders in one call are filed under a single project; call once per project.

tools.name: smi_submit_deep_reports
tools.description: Submits previously created SMI deep report drafts (Draft status only) for processing.

tools.name: smi_request_upload_url
tools.description: Requests a presigned URL for uploading a large deep-report reference file (csv, doc, docx, gif, jpg, jpeg, pdf, png, txt, webp, xls, xlsx) directly to storage. This server never proxies file bytes: the caller must PUT the file to the returned signedUrl, capture the x-amz-version-id response header f

tools.name: smi_confirm_upload
tools.description: Confirms a file already PUT to a presigned URL returned by smi_request_upload_url and persists the deep report upload record. Requires the version (the x-amz-version-id response header captured during the PUT).

tools.name: smi_list_exports
tools.description: Lists SMI exports with pagination and optional filtering.

tools.name: smi_get_export
tools.description: Fetches a single SMI export by id. Accepts product-prefixed ids: EX-30001 resolves here, while RB and DR ids belong to smi_get_deep_report.

tools.name: smi_create_export
tools.description: Creates one or more SMI export drafts from profile-url orders. Returns the draft ids for review before submission. All orders in one call are filed under a single project; call once per project.

tools.name: smi_submit_exports
tools.description: Submits previously created SMI export drafts (Draft status only) for processing.

tools.name: smi_list_projects
tools.description: Lists SMI projects with pagination.

tools.name: smi_list_products
tools.description: Lists the SMI reference set of products.

tools.name: smi_list_platforms
tools.description: Lists the SMI reference set of platforms.

tools.name: smi_list_statuses
tools.description: Lists the SMI reference set of statuses.

tools.name: smi_list_relationships
tools.description: Lists the SMI reference set of relationships.

tools.name: smi_get_report_findings
tools.description: Lists SMI release findings with pagination and optional filtering by report, platform, scope, and confirmation status. tools.name: smi_get_deep_report_releases
tools.description: Lists releases for a given SMI deep report, with pagination. Each release links its downloadable deliverable files (report PDF, CSV, JSON) and the findings screenshot archive when available — use this tool to fetch the generated report PDF.

tools.name: smi_get_export_releases
tools.description: Lists releases for a given SMI export, with pagination.

If you already have a plain SMI record id, use smi_get_deep_report or smi_get_export to read it, or smi_check_order_complete for its readine

tools.description: Attaches a postal address to an SMI subject.

tools.name: smi_add_subject_phone
tools.description: Attaches a phone number to an SMI subject.

tools.name: smi_add_subject_email
tools.description: Attaches an email address to an SMI subject.

tools.name: smi_add_subject_alias
tools.description: Attaches an alias to an SMI subject.

tools.name: smi_add_subject_employer

tools.name: smi_add_subject_employee

tools.description: Attaches a url to an SMI subject employee, referenced by the subjectEmployeeId returned from smi_add_subject_employee.

tools.name: smi_add_subject_education

tools.name: smi_add_subject_relationship_url
tools.description: Attaches a url to an SMI subject relationship, referenced by the subjectRelationshipId returned from smi_add_subject_relationship.

tools.name: smi_update_subject
tools.description: Partially updates an SMI subject via PATCH /subjects/:id. type (PERSON or COMPANY) is required on every call — the SMI backend requires it as a discriminator on every subject PATCH. Editable fields match the API contract: firstName/lastName (or companyName for a COMPANY), birthYear/birthMonth/birthD

tools.name: smi_get_subject
tools.description: Reads a subject's full profile out of a deep report (no standalone GET /subjects/{id} exists upstream, so the input is a deepReportId, not a subject id). Returns the subject as structured JSON — any atomic field (e.g. date of birth via `subject.birthDate`) can be extracted from it directly.

findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: smi_get_report_findings, search · Private data: onboarding_next_step, verify_access, submit_contact_request, smi_request_upload_url, smi_confirm_upload, smi_get_report_findings, smi_get_deep_report_releases, smi_check_order_complete, search, fetch · Public sink: submit_contact_request, smi_submit_deep_reports, smi_request_upload_url, smi_confirm_upload, smi_submit_exports, smi_add_subject_email.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: smi_get_report_findings, search · Private data: onboarding_next_step, verify_access, submit_contact_request, smi_request_upload_url, smi_confirm_upload, smi_get_report_findings, smi_get_deep_report_releases, smi_check_order_complete, search, fetch · Public sink: submit_contact_request, smi_submit_deep_reports, smi_request_upload_url, smi_confirm_upload, smi_submit_exports, smi_add_subject_email

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "smi_request_upload_url" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
